svg.text: The message the bench constructs and the V2X ECU receives
ETSI CPM, TS 103 324 release 2 — exactly two containers and exactly one perceived object per message.
position x, y — 0.01 m, in sender B's frame
one raw UPER-encoded message per UDP datagram,
with no GeoNetworking or BTP envelope — that stack
resides in the modem and is outside the project.
Distance is not transmitted: the receiver derives it
from the x and y offsets.
containers 2, 3 and 4, and 14 optional object fields
